summary: iter90fu two-bug fix verified. BUG1 (backend total/total_amount alignment) validated with 3 pytest cases (all PASS). BUG2 (BudgetWizard default Date du 1er appel = FY.start_date) validated end-to-end via Playwright: input showed 01/01/2025 (FY 2025 start), calendrier prevu correctly generated 4 quarterly appels in 2025. Fallback branch reviewed in code.
critical_code_review_comments: BudgetWizard.js: fiscalYear default is null, guarded correctly (fiscalYear && fiscalYear.start_date). Retro-compat fallback to first-of-current-month is safe.
fiscal.py list_budgets self-heals but silently swallows update errors (except: pass). OK for backfill idempotence, but consider logging under debug to trace legacy budget drift.
commit_budget post-write verification only re-writes total/total_amount if missing (safety-net). Considered defensive but adds an extra find_one on every commit — negligible cost, acceptable.
seed_data_creation: Ephemeral: seeded 1 approved budget (id=b3aba2f5-...) for the FY 2025 to enable BUG2 E2E, then deleted at end. Backend tests each create/delete their own budget docs and distribution keys with TESTFU prefix.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests are pure-sync via requests+pymongo (no pytest-asyncio available). Alpha ACP FY2025 has start_date=2025-01-01, end_date=2025-12-31 — ideal to test date-default fixes. Route to Budgets tab is /fiscal (not /fiscal-years). Syndic setup wizard modal auto-opens on first login of syndic_alpha; dismiss via Escape/X before Playwright interactions.
rca of the issue: BUG1 root cause = field-name divergence between wizard writer (total_amount) and list-card reader (total). Fix writes both fields and self-heals legacy docs on read. BUG2 root cause = BudgetWizard defaulted startDate to first-of-current-month; fix threads fiscalYear prop from FiscalYearPage and uses fiscalYear.start_date.
